description:
Default joint position offsets (radians) for the Open Duck Mini v2 action post-processing: target = init_pos + action_scale * action.

TWO ORDERS, and they are NOT the same length since Task M0b (2026-08-13).
`joint_order` is the full 16-joint Isaac Lab / USD ARTICULATION order (breadth-first, interleaved) and is the order of the joint_pos/joint_vel state arrays. `action_joint_order` is the 14 joints the POLICY commands: the same order with left_antenna and right_antenna removed.

The antennas are still joints on the robot and still have an actuator; the policy simply neither reads nor writes them, because on hardware they are open-loop SG90s with no position feedback (known_issues.md DEPLOY-3). The runtime MUST hold them at their init_pos and must NOT expect the policy to produce a target for them.
